title: Fall Semester Goals
text:
Fall 2026 goals



Survive the MCAT
Develop a strong background in ciliate biology and the molecular basis of adaptation
Begin analysis of genome rearrangment in Loxodes
Design experiments for studying adaptation in Tetrahymena thermophilia




Read primary literature on the molecular basis of adaptation and ciliate biology
Maintain annotated bibliography





Analyze existing Loxodes data to examine germline-soma genome rearrangement and structure
Maintain Tetrahymena thermophila cultures
Develop methods for measuring phenotypic responses in T. thermophilia, including growth rate, cell morphometrics, swimming behavior, and mating
Develop methods for measuring molecular changes via RNA sequencing, single nucleotide polymorphisms (SNPs), and copy number variation (CNV) and look for structural rearrangements
